title: studio(data): Field properties inspector stays open on Validations/Hooks/Actions/API/Settings, and read-only packages keep edit wording ("Draft layout", "saved as draft")
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: Studio → showcase (read-only) → any object.

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the Studio / app-shell owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of Studio on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

- Open a field's *Field properties* on the Form tab, then switch Advanced → Validations / Hooks / Actions / API / Settings: the field inspector stays open on every sub-panel (Escape does not close it).
- On a read-only package the Form tab still says "Draft layout" and "Drag to reorder / move across groups · click a field to edit its properties"; Access shows an orange "This package's objects · saved as draft".
- Read-only validation inputs are `disabled` but keep the editable look (white fill, dark text), unlike the greyed field inspector.

## Expected

The inspector belongs to the tab that opened it; read-only packages use read-only wording and disabled styling throughout.

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Close the field inspector on sub-panel change; branch the captions on `readOnly`; apply the shared disabled style to the validation editor.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *field properties inspector stays open read-only package draft layout saved as draft wording*: 8 hits (0 open, 8 closed).
- Related, not the same defect:
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#11167 (closed) — same read-only-package-still-editable family, Interfaces pillar
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#11136 (closed) — same family, page inspectors
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#11124 (closed) — same family, Automations pillar
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.

Dedupe words: field inspector stays open other tab · read-only package draft layout wording · saved as draft read-only
